local defaultW = 530
local defaultH = 310
local savedScale = 1
pcall(function()
    if isfile and isfile("DakyHub_Settings.json") then
        local data = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile("DakyHub_Settings.json"))
        if data and data.scale then savedScale = tonumber(data.scale) or 1 end
    end
end)

local function saveScale(val)
    pcall(function()
        if writefile then
            writefile("DakyHub_Settings.json", HttpService:JSONEncode({scale = val}))
        end
    end)
end

local dragging = false
local dragStart = nil
local startPos = nil

mainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = mainFrame.Position
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = false
    end
end)

local tabs = {}
local function createTab(name)
    local tabContent = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", container)
    tabContent.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    tabContent.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    tabContent.ScrollBarThickness = 3
    tabContent.Visible = false
    tabContent.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    tabContent.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", tabContent)
    layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)

    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", sidebar)
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 35)
    btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
    btn.Text = "  " .. name
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 180)
    btn.TextSize = 11
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.2, 0)

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        for _, t in pairs(tabs) do
            if t.content.Visible then
                TweenService:Create(t.content, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 0)}):Play()
                task.delay(0.12, function() t.content.Visible = false end)
            end
            TweenService:Create(t.button, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
                TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 180),
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 35)
            }):Play()
        end
        tabContent.Position = UDim2.new(0, -15, 0, 0)
        tabContent.Visible = true
        TweenService:Create(tabContent, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 30, 230)
        }):Play()
    end)

    tabs[name] = {content = tabContent, button = btn}
    return tabContent
end

for _, name in ipairs(tabNames) do

local sliderDrag = false
local function updateSlider(input)
    local posRel = math.clamp((input.Position.X - sliderBg.AbsolutePosition.X) / sliderBg.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
    sliderFill.Size = UDim2.new(posRel, 0, 1, 0)
    local newScale = 0.8 + (posRel * 0.45)
    sliderText.Text = "Escala: " .. math.floor(newScale * 100) .. "%"
    local newW = math.floor(defaultW * newScale)
    local newH = math.floor(defaultH * newScale)
    local centerPos = mainFrame.Position + UDim2.new(0, mainFrame.AbsoluteSize.X/2, 0, mainFrame.AbsoluteSize.Y/2)
    mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, newW, 0, newH)
    mainFrame.Position = centerPos - UDim2.new(0, newW/2, 0, newH/2)
    saveScale(newScale)
end

sliderBg.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        sliderDrag = true
        updateSlider(input)
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        sliderDrag = false
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if sliderDrag and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        updateSlider(input)
    end
end)

local function getUI()
    local g = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
    local hub = g.AsukykHub
    if type(hub) ~= "table" then
        hub = { slots = {} }
        g.AsukykHub = hub
    end
    if type(hub.slots) ~= "table" then
        hub.slots = {}
    end
    local str = tostring(LocalPlayer.UserId or 0)
    local slot = hub.slots[str]
    if type(slot) ~= "table" then
        slot = {}
        hub.slots[str] = slot
    end
    return slot.UI
end

local function isAutoStealOn()
    local ui = getUI()
    if ui and ui.Flags then
        return ui.Flags.AutoSteal == true
    end
    return false
end

local function toggleAutoSteal()
    local ui = getUI()
    if ui and ui.Widgets and ui.Widgets.AutoSteal then
        local widget = ui.Widgets.AutoSteal
        local newState = not isAutoStealOn()
        if widget.set then widget.set(newState) end
        if widget.on then widget.on(newState) end
        return newState
    end
    return nil
end

if not game:IsLoaded() then
    game.Loaded:Wait()
end

do
    local str
    do
        local Players = game:GetService("Players")
        local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
        if not LocalPlayer then
            pcall(function()
                Players:GetPropertyChangedSignal("LocalPlayer"):Wait()
            end)
            LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
        end
        str = tostring(LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer.UserId or 0)
    end

    local v4 = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
    local AsukykHub = v4.AsukykHub
    if type(AsukykHub) ~= "table" then
        AsukykHub = { slots = {} }
        v4.AsukykHub = AsukykHub
    end
    if type(AsukykHub.slots) ~= "table" then
        AsukykHub.slots = {}
    end

    local unload
    do
        local v6 = AsukykHub.slots[str]
        if type(v6) ~= "table" then
            v6 = {}
            AsukykHub.slots[str] = v6
        end
        v6.gen = (tonumber(v6.gen) or 0) + 1
        local v7 = false
        for k, v in pairs(AsukykHub.slots) do
            if str ~= tostring(k) and type(v) == "table" and v.alive == true then
                v7 = true
                break
            end
        end
        if not v7 then
            v4.AsukykCfgGen = (tonumber(v4.AsukykCfgGen) or 0) + 1
        end
        unload = v6.unload
        v6.unload = nil
        v6.alive = false
    end

    if type(unload) == "function" then
        pcall(unload)
    elseif type(v4.AsukykUnload) == "function" then
        local AsukykUnloadUid = v4.AsukykUnloadUid
        local v12 = AsukykUnloadUid == nil or str == tostring(AsukykUnloadUid)
        if AsukykUnloadUid == nil then
            for k, v in pairs(AsukykHub.slots) do
                if str ~= tostring(k) and type(v) == "table" and type(v.unload) == "function" then
                    v12 = false
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if v12 then
            local AsukykUnload = v4.AsukykUnload
            if str == tostring(AsukykUnloadUid or str) then
                v4.AsukykUnload = nil
                v4.AsukykUnloadUid = nil
            end
            pcall(AsukykUnload)
        end
    end
end

do
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
    if not LocalPlayer then
        pcall(function()
            Players:GetPropertyChangedSignal("LocalPlayer"):Wait()
        end)
        LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
    end
    local v18 = os.clock() + 60
    while LocalPlayer and v18 > os.clock() do
        local v20, v21
        do
            local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
            v20 = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            v21 = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        end
        if v20 and v21 and v20.Health > 0 then
            task.wait(0.45)
            local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
            local v23 = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local v24 = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not v23 or not v24 or not (v23.Health > 0) then
                continue
            end
            break
        end
        task.wait(0.1)
    end
end

local function v26(p1)
    local v328 = tostring(p1 or "Game"):gsub("[<>:\"/\\|?*]", "_"):gsub("%s+", "_"):gsub("_+", "_"):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
    if not v328 or v328 == "" or v328 == "_" then
        v328 = "Game"
    end
    return v328
end

local function v40()
    if UserInputService.VREnabled then return false end
    local isTouch = false
    pcall(function()
        if UserInputService.TouchEnabled then isTouch = true end
    end)
    if isTouch then return true end
    pcall(function()
        if UserInputService.MouseEnabled == false then isTouch = true end
    end)
    if isTouch then return true end
    local hasGyro = false
    local hasAccel = false
    pcall(function()
        hasGyro = UserInputService.GyroscopeEnabled == true
    end)
    pcall(function()
        hasAccel = UserInputService.AccelerometerEnabled == true
    end)
    if hasGyro or hasAccel then return true end
    local preferredInput
    pcall(function()
        preferredInput = UserInputService.PreferredInput
    end)
    if preferredInput == Enum.PreferredInput.Touch then return true end
    local lastInputType
    pcall(function()
        lastInputType = UserInputService:GetLastInputType()
    end)
    if lastInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return true end
    pcall(function()
        local v343 = LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        if v343 then
            if v343:FindFirstChild("TouchGui", true) or
               v343:FindFirstChild("TouchControlFrame", true) or
               v343:FindFirstChild("JumpButton", true) or
               v343:FindFirstChild("DynamicThumbstickFrame", true) then
                isTouch = true
            end
        end
    end)
    if isTouch then return true end
    return false
end

local function v41()
    local CurrentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local v345
    -- =============================================
-- PARTE 2/4: CONTINUAÇÃO DO ASUKYKHUB
-- LINHAS 651 A 1300 (COMPLETA)
-- =============================================

    if not CurrentCamera then
        v345 = Vector2.new(1280, 720)
    else
        v345 = CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
    end
    local v346 = math.floor(math.clamp(v345.X * 0.7, 440, 560))
    local v347 = math.floor(math.clamp(v345.Y * 0.74, 340, 410))
    if v345.X > 80 then
        v346 = math.min(v346, v345.X - 36)
    end
    if v345.Y > 80 then
        v347 = math.min(v347, v345.Y - 36)
    end
    return math.max(400, v346), math.max(320, v347)
end
